# Nesting and markup boundaries

Nested quoting resolves from local context: "she said 'hello' to me" reads correctly.

A quote directly inside emphasis delimiters resolves too: **"quoted"** and *'quoted'* and _"underscored"_.

Parenthesized quoting works the same way: (a "parenthetical" aside).
A bracketed span is not prose, though: [a "bracketed" one] could be a shortcut reference link, so it is protected and stays straight.
